notes: PILOT: training loss and tail family. Stack on the base: python -m dskit.pipeline workflow configs/workflow.json --args configs/pilot-base.json --args configs/pilot-crps-student.json. The manifest trains TorchCDF with Gaussian components on 0.1 x NLL + wing twCRPS; NLL chases outliers and Gaussian components understate fat tails, and the step-7 runs found the models too optimistic on the downside (10% of outcomes below the 5th percentile). This run swaps both everywhere (steps 4 to 7): CRPS (robust, the scored metric) plus wing twCRPS, Student components, and the step-6 grid searches only the degrees of freedom (4, 8, 30; 30 is near-Gaussian) at the manifest's default width and learning rate, so 3 candidates instead of 9. Compare its report with pilot-base's: same folds, same references.
